_comment: Bloomberg Tech's own on-air lower third, measured off a native 1920x1080 frame of youtu.be/g-YDNJcyuck (t=150s) rather than eyeballed: a square-cornered white slab with black bold uppercase, and a mint rule under it. The rule is the whole identity -- without it the slab is just a white box -- so it is drawn by card.rule, not faked with a second preset. The active word takes the amber Bloomberg uses to highlight the selected row of its own ticker; mint and up-green both fail on white. Typeface is Montserrat Bold because it is what this repo ships; Bloomberg's own face is a CONDENSED grotesque, so real lines run ~15% wider here than on air. Landscape original; the 9:16 cut uses bloomberg-tech-vertical.json.

_measured.banner_card: #FFFFFF, x 422-1781 (1360 px), y 920-1017 (98 px), square corners

overlays._note: Colour of the SOURCE video's own lower-third graphics to dodge (not your card colour). Targeted mode is reliable; auto is experimental and false-positives on saturated props.
